title: Rabbi Benayah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rabbi Huna’s student; Benayah speaks in Huna’s name in Pesikta deRav Kahana 24b, Ruth Rabbah 1:2 and Midrash Shmuel 18:2. In Kohelet Rabbah 7:16 the statement of Midrash Shmuel reads “Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Benayah.” Hyman suggests that perhaps he is the Rabbi Benai above.

notes.text: Ruth Rabbah has Benayah reporting in Rabbi Huna’s name, and Midrash Shmuel has Benai reporting in Rav Huna’s name. The consulted Kohelet Rabbah names two transmitters together and distributes the material about Saul and the heifer differently. The exact Buber reference remains Hyman’s report.
